title: West Coast Swing Basic Steps (Everyone teaches this wrong)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The male instructor leads the explanation and conceptual breakdown while the female partner demonstrates. They use verbal repetition to reinforce core structural ideas before diving into specific movement patterns.

lesson_structure.note: Introduce the overview of West Coast Swing basics
Overview of the five main things to know
Explanation and demonstration of side passes, sugar pushes, rolling passes, whips, and wrap-ins
Reviewing side passes and discussing sugar push mistakes

metaphors: <setting you in a path to fail>

steps_taught.name: <side passes>
steps_taught.description: <moving from one side of the track to the other>

steps_taught.name: <sugar pushes>
steps_taught.description: <leader blocks follower as she comes forward and sends her back>

what_works: <simplifying complex figures into five core concepts>
what_hinders: <talking through demonstrations rather than step-by-step counts>

quotes.text: <What if I told you that West Coast Swing was not as complicated as you thought?>
<There is only a handful of things you can do>
<One common mistake that dance teachers make and that new dancers make is they learn the sugar push first>

extraction.distinctive_method: <Focuses heavily on teaching side passes before sugar pushes to avoid common conceptual errors in West Coast Swing>
